confirmedFindings.title: Dynamic Realm Extraction from Untrusted Contact Header
confirmedFindings.body: Extracting the digest authentication challenge realm directly from unauthenticated client Contact headers allows an attacker to specify arbitrary realm domains, triggering hash mismatch or credential harvesting attacks.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Use server-configured canonical realm domains matched against trusted tenant domains.
